subject.title: [Feature]: Improve gateway stop/uninstall to handle system-level LaunchDaemons

question: What privileged macOS LaunchDaemon lifecycle contract should OpenClaw support for gateway stop/uninstall and the related install/status surfaces?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow code repair because it decides sudo/operator UX, root-owned plist mutation, execution user, service environment durability, and coexistence between user LaunchAgents and system LaunchDaemons.

options.title: Explicit Audited System Scope
options.body: Keep user LaunchAgent as the default, add an explicit system-scope lifecycle or guidance flow, and align install/status/stop/uninstall/doctor/docs/tests before implementation.

options.title: Diagnostic Guidance Only
options.body: Do not manage LaunchDaemons from OpenClaw yet; improve status and doctor guidance so operators can safely use launchctl manually.

options.title: Full Managed LaunchDaemon Mode
options.body: Add first-class install/status/start/stop/uninstall support for LaunchDaemons, accepting the larger privileged-service surface after owner review.

recommendation.title: Explicit Audited System Scope
recommendation.body: Keep user LaunchAgent as the default, add an explicit system-scope lifecycle or guidance flow, and align install/status/stop/uninstall/doctor/docs/tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal for the gateway lifecycle command and service adapter boundary.
